title: What if the zombie apocalypse happened?

lines.text: What if the zombie apocalypse happened?
It starts on an ordinary morning. You step outside, coffee in hand. Across the street, someone bites a stranger. Then the infected double, and double again.
By mid-morning the roads are jammed, and the sidewalks are worse. You don't run far. You run up. Your own fire escape is the safest road left.
By noon, the power grid fails. No phones, no water, no help coming. You drag everything you can find in front of the rooftop door.
By sunset, the city is theirs. Nine in ten people are gone. The ones who made it stayed quiet, and stayed high.
At night, the real danger isn't the dead. It's hunger, thirst, and the people beside you. Before dawn, one of your neighbors slips away.
So, when the food runs out, where do you go? The rooftop, or the supermarket?
